checklist.item: The rating of the wall or floor is stated and the firestop system has the same F rating (and T rating where required).
checklist.why: A firestop is only valid as a tested system matched to the assembly.

checklist.item: A tested system number (for example a listing reference) is called out, or the detail says the contractor submits one for each condition.
checklist.why: Generic 'fire caulk' notes do not pass inspection.

checklist.item: Annular space, penetrant type and size, sleeve and insulation on the pipe are shown, since each changes the system.
checklist.why: The listing depends on exactly these items.

checklist.item: Backing material and sealant depth are shown.
checklist.why: Depth is part of the tested system.

checklist.item: Where the floor needs it, a W (water) or L (smoke leakage) rating is noted.
checklist.why: Required in some occupancies and for smoke barriers.

checklist.item: Membrane penetrations (boxes, recessed items) are distinguished from through-penetrations.
